title: Latticed Shoulder Creel
description: One original low-poly static fishing-creel exterior, counted as one prop. A broad oval belly tapers into a narrower shoulder and continuous neck rim. Sixteen thick upright strips and five full horizontal bands form one welded closed lattice boundary with sixty-four actual through-windows, each bounded by four thick sides. A complete thick flat oval floor connects finitely to the lower band. A fixed thick lid rests over the full finite neck-rim face and contains a genuine front-offset oval drop opening; the opening, neck and belly lead to one actual empty cavity above the bottom. One thick rear-offset arch handle has two finite embedded shoulder ends and stays clear of the opening. Four editable closed components and three opaque constant PBR materials. The wide belly, closed flat bottom, narrow covered shoulder and offset drop opening are newly authored geometry, not a recoloured harvest basket, upside-down hat net or modified landing net. Metres, native Z up, ground-centre origin, front -Y. Fixed pose only. No fish, water, loose contents, second basket, scene, strap variant, textures, transparency, labels, animation or branding. Welded stylized geometric strips do not represent an actual weaving process. Static visual geometry only. No actual holding, capacity, drainage, ventilation, fish survival, capture, food or material safety, human grip fit, carrying load, durability, stability, manufacturing, fishing or other safety performance is claimed. No interface compatibility with prior fishing assets is claimed.
